senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בק , v. בקע) to enter into, to clear, split; whence
(= בער) to eat up. Denom. בָּקָר (= בְּעִיר).
(= בער) to break forth, shine. Denom. בֹּקֶר.
to enter into, examine, search, distinguish (cmp. בִּין).
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 106a:8">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>מְבַקְּרֵי מומין</he> those entrusted with the examination of sacrificial animals. Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ top <he>ובִיקְּרָן ממומן</he> and had them examined (and declared free) from bodily defects.

Ḥag. 9ᵇ אין אומרים בַּקְּרוּ וכ׳ we do not say, Examine ye a camel, a swine &c. (i.e. only the deeds of distinguished persons are scrutinized); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְבוּקָּר examined and found fit. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ top טליים מְבוּקָּרִים lambs which passed examination.

senses.gloss: to inquire after one’s health, to visit the sick.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 4:4">Ned. IV, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 38b">38ᵇ</cite>). <he>ונכנס לְבַקְּרוֹ</he> and comes to see him.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr. [Ruth. R. to II, 15, v. infra.]
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81">Gen. R. s. 81</cite> <he>פנקסו נִתְבַּקְּרָה</he> his account is examined (his sins visited); Tanḥ. Vayishlaḥ 8 <he>מִתְבַּקֶּרֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite>, read with <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 141:3">Yalk. Gen. 141</cite> <he>נתב׳ פנקסי</he> my account &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:21">Num. R. s. 18</cite> as all sick persons <he>מִתְבַּקְּרִין</he> are tended (by physicians).

senses.gloss: (Y. Dial. for הִפְקִיר, v. פָּקַר; v. next w.) to give free, to resign ownership, to declare a property ownerless. Y. Ned. IV, 38ᵈ; Y. Peah V, beg. 19ᵇ [read:] כיון שאדם מַבְקִיר דבר יצא מרשותו as soon as one declares a thing to be free, it has gone out of his control; Y. Dem. III, 23ᵇ bot. כיון שאדם מ׳ … ויצא … הבקירו הבקר as soon as one gives a thing free and it has left his possession, his act is valid; a. fr. [Ruth. R. to II, 15 מבקר, מבדר, prob. מבקיר; v. בָּדַר.]
to be declared free, to be free. Y. Peah VI, 19ᶜ top.—Part. מוּבְקָר Ib. 19ᵇ bot. שדי מוּבְקֶרֶת וכ׳ (Tosef. Maasr. III, 11. הרי … מופ׳) my field shall be free for one day &c.; a. e.
